summary: SmartFix full-platform (quotations + tickets + finance + audit + role mgmt + notifications) — backend & frontend tested end-to-end. BACKEND: 99/99 pytest pass (35 legacy regression + 31 role/audit + 33 NEW platform tests). One 500 was found & fixed on PATCH /api/admin/users/{uid}/role (Mongo _id ObjectId leaking into response) — root cause: `return {'user': {**target, ...}}` included raw mongo doc. Fixed by stripping _id/password_hash. FRONTEND: mobile viewport 390x844, all critical flows verified — (a) customer1 login → home → tap 'AC General Service' → Book Now → Confirm-booking screen shows both saved addresses with Office as DEFAULT (green pill) pre-selected, Home/Sunrise visible below → **default-address regression PASS**. (b) tech1 login → /provider dashboard shows 'My Jobs' with active/completed cards + earnings summary. (c) owner login → /admin with all 9 tabs rendered via testID admin-tab-{overview,bookings,services,providers,coupons,users,support,finance,audit}. Support tab shows 'Missed appointment' HIGH priority ticket with IN_PROGRESS pill and clickable status chips (OPEN/IN_PROGRESS/WAITING_CUSTOMER/RESOLVED/CLOSED). Finance tab shows KPI cards (Total Revenue ₹7235.5, Cash ₹2994, UPI ₹4241.5, Awaiting Verify ₹0, Pending ₹16126.1) + Ledger. Audit tab lists BOOKING_COMPLETED, TECHNICIAN_ASSIGNED, ROLE_CHANGED, BOOKING_CREATED entries. Users tab shows inline role dropdown pill per user. Quotation security & business logic verified via pytest: token = 43-char base64url from token_urlsafe(32), only sha256 hash stored, raw token returned ONLY to owning technician, hidden from customer/owner GETs; totals server-computed exactly (450 parts + 200 labour, tax 18% = 117 → total 767); public GET auto-marks VIEWED, second /respond returns 400 'already accepted'; random token → 404; SF-Q-YYYY-NNNN human number; wa.me link returned only when customer_phone set. Booking history chronological with changed_by_role=TECHNICIAN. Notifications for customer include BOOKING_CREATED, TECHNICIAN_ASSIGNED, QUOTATION_CREATED. Role change audited; customer1 forbidden 403. Permissions API shape {role, vendor_id, permissions:{...}} confirmed.

minor.issue: Response returned raw MongoDB doc with ObjectId `_id`, causing 500 (ValueError: 'ObjectId' object is not iterable / vars() argument must have __dict__). FIXED in this iteration by stripping _id and password_hash before merging.

critical_code_review_comments: Quotation security is well-implemented: secrets.token_urlsafe(32) + sha256 stored as token_hash, raw token returned only to owning tech, _safe_quotation() strips token_hash always and token unless owner-tech.
Server-side totals recomputation prevents client tampering — parts vs labour split, discount applied before tax, sane rounding.
Public /respond enforces sticky ACCEPTED/REJECTED/EXPIRED with clear 400 message; expiry auto-flip on read is idempotent.
audit_log writes on QUOTATION_CREATED/SENT/ACCEPTED/REJECTED, TECHNICIAN_ASSIGNED, TICKET_CREATED/UPDATED, ROLE_CHANGED, PAYMENT_VERIFIED, all BOOKING_* transitions — full trail.
Bug: change_user_role returned raw target dict (with Mongo _id) — fixed. Same pattern risk in any endpoint doing `{**doc, ...}` on find_one() results.

Frontend admin.tsx uses testID `admin-tab-{tab}` (lowercase) with CSS textTransform capitalize — tabs render visually as 'Users', 'Support', etc. Any DOM-text assertion must use lowercase or the testID.

rca_of_issue: Bug: PATCH /api/admin/users/{uid}/role → 500 ValueError. RCA: server.py:1311 returned `{'user': {**target, **upd, 'password_hash': None}}` where `target` was a raw find_one() result still carrying a MongoDB ObjectId `_id`. FastAPI's jsonable_encoder failed on ObjectId (not JSON-serializable / not __dict__-iterable). Repro: PATCH /api/admin/users/<any-uid>/role with body {'role':'TECHNICIAN'} as owner → 500. Mitigation applied: build a `safe_target = {k:v for k,v in target.items() if k not in ('_id','password_hash')}` then spread. Verified by re-running TestRoleMgmtAndAudit → 3/3 pass, then full suite → 99/99 pass.
